text: What is the 40-man roster in baseball? MLB's Nov. 17 deadline, explained. The 40-man roster is the group of up to 40 players a Major League team controls: everyone on the 26-man active roster, players on the 7-, 10- and 15-day injured lists and some minor leaguers. Being on it protects a prospect from the Rule 5 Draft, and the 2026 deadline to add players is Nov. 17.. MLB teams must set their 40-man rosters by Nov. 17, 2026, to protect prospects from the Rule 5 Draft.. MLB's glossary says the 40-man roster combines players on the 26-man roster, the 7-, 10- and 15-day injured lists, the bereavement and paternity lists, and some minor leaguers. A team with a full 40-man roster must clear a spot before calling up a minor leaguer who is not on it, for example by moving an injured player to the 60-day injured list. Players on the 40-man roster usually get three option years to be sent to the minors; a player out of options must be designated for assignment and clear waivers first. Each November, teams decide which prospects to add. Players signed at 18 or younger must be added within five seasons, and those signed at 19 or older within four, or they become eligible to be taken by another team in the Rule 5 Draft. In 2026, the deadline is Nov. 17, followed by the non-tender deadline on Nov. 20.

Did Trump call into C-SPAN? Yes, on Nov. 9, 2026: what he said. Yes. President Donald Trump phoned into C-SPAN on Monday night, Nov. 9, 2026, during the premiere of the new show "Washington Journal Primetime," hosted by Mimi Geerges. He came on about 10 minutes into the program and talked about viewer call-ins, the Hegseth impeachment push and the Iran war.. Searches for "trump calls cspan" and "did trump call into cspan" broke out on Nov. 10, 2026, after the call.. Trump told Geerges he watches C-SPAN's call-in segments because "it gives me a little bit of an indication of where we are," adding that Republican callers seemed pleased and Democrats less so. He said he would be disappointed in Republicans who vote to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, saying, "Pete has won two wars," and discussed the war with Iran, saying "We could knock it out fast." He also talked about deportation policy. The call was the latest in a run of surprise media appearances after the Nov. 3 midterm elections. Earlier, after a Supreme Court tariff ruling, C-SPAN said a viral caller who identified himself as "John Barron" was not Trump, so many people searched to check whether this call was real. This one was real: it aired during the show, and outlets including CNBC reported on it.

When does The Keepsake Sea come out? Dreamlight Valley's Nov. 18 expansion. Disney Dreamlight Valley's next expansion, The Keepsake Sea, comes out on Nov. 18, 2026. It lets players turn into Merfolk and explore underwater, and adds villagers including Captain Jack Sparrow, Megara, Milo Thatch, Captain Hook and Wendy. Base-game owners buy it as an add-on bundle with 5,000 Moonstones.. The Nov. 18, 2026, launch date was confirmed in the 2026 Disney Dreamlight Valley showcase.. The story starts at Dazzle Beach, where players set out to awaken four Guardians across three island biomes: Shipwreck Shores, Candy Cove and the Kingdom of Oublié. As Merfolk, players can swim across surface water and dive into ripples to catch fish instantly. The expansion also adds Adventure Companions, a new companion type, starting with Dory; Flounder and Sebastian come with the Deluxe Edition. The Enchanted Pirate Ship gets a salvaging crane, a customizable sail and flag, room for up to two villagers and a decorable Captain's Cabin. The Deluxe Edition includes 10,000 Moonstones, and owners of the Arcade Edition get the expansion on day one at no extra cost. The base game is on PC, PlayStation 4 and 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch.

Is Madden a true story? Nicolas Cage's John Madden movie, explained. Yes. "Madden," streaming on Prime Video from Nov. 18, 2026, is a biopic inspired by the real life of John Madden, the Raiders' Super Bowl-winning coach who became a famous broadcaster and the namesake of the Madden NFL video game. Nicolas Cage plays Madden; David O. Russell directed.. "Madden" premieres on Prime Video on Nov. 18, 2026, in the middle of the NFL season.. Amazon says the film follows Madden from his Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, through his rise as a broadcaster, to building the Madden NFL game. Christian Bale plays Raiders owner Al Davis, Kathryn Hahn plays Madden's wife, Virginia, Sienna Miller plays Davis' wife, Carol, and John Mulaney plays EA Sports founder Trip Hawkins. Shane Gillis also appears. Russell wrote the script after an earlier draft by Cambron Clark. The movie skipped theaters and premieres globally on Prime Video, included with a Prime membership. The real John Madden coached the Raiders from 1969 to 1978, going 112-32-14 with 10 playoff appearances, and won Super Bowl XI after the 1976 season. He called NFL games from 1979 to 2008 for CBS, Fox, ABC and NBC. The video game series began in 1988 as "John Madden Football." He was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2006 and died on Dec. 28, 2021, at 85.

When is Red Cup Day 2026? Tuesday, Nov. 17, at Starbucks. Starbucks Red Cup Day 2026 is Tuesday, Nov. 17. Customers get a free, limited-edition reusable red holiday cup with the purchase of a seasonal beverage. Starbucks' holiday menu, with drinks such as the Peppermint Mocha and Caramel Brulée Latte, has been available since Nov. 5.. Starbucks' free reusable red cup giveaway returns on Nov. 17, 2026.. Starbucks announced the date in its 2026 holiday lineup. The returning holiday drinks include the Peppermint Mocha, Caramel Brulée Latte, Sugar Cookie Latte and Gingerbread Chai, all on the menu since Nov. 5, 2026. Red Cup Day falls between two other holiday merchandise drops: a mystery "Surprise Box" collection of glass Bearista cold cups that went on sale Nov. 10, and the original Bearista glass cup, which returns to select coffeehouses on Dec. 1.

Is The Good Daughter based on a book? Yes, Karin Slaughter's novel. Yes. Peacock's "The Good Daughter," premiering Nov. 12, 2026, is adapted from Karin Slaughter's bestselling 2017 novel of the same name. Slaughter wrote all six episodes herself. It is fiction, not a true story, though the story is set in the small town of Pikeville and was filmed in and around Atlanta.. All six episodes of "The Good Daughter" drop on Peacock on Nov. 12, 2026.. The limited series stars Rose Byrne as Samantha Quinn and Meghann Fahy as Charlotte Quinn, two sisters who have spent 20 years rebuilding lives broken by one night of violence. When another attack hits their town of Pikeville, Charlotte, a lawyer like her father, is the first witness on the scene. Brendan Gleeson plays their father, Rusty Quinn, and Olivia Williams plays their mother, Harriet "Gamma" Quinn. All six episodes premiere on Peacock on Nov. 12, 2026. Slaughter created the series and made her screenwriting debut on it; Steph Green directed every episode. Other cast members include Harper Steele as Lenore, Michael Dorman as Ben, and Audrey Grace Marshall and Drew Cheek as young Sam and young Charlie.

Is Vienna Game a true story? The real Congress of Vienna behind it. Partly. Hulu's "Vienna Game," out Nov. 18, 2026, is a satirical drama set at the real Congress of Vienna of 1814-15, and its heroine is based on a real noblewoman, Wilhelmine, Duchess of Sagan. But it is a satire with dramatized plot lines, not a documentary account.. "Vienna Game" premieres on Hulu on Nov. 18, 2026; it streams on Disney+ in other countries.. The six-part German series follows Wilhelmine von Sagan (Marlene Tanczik) through diplomacy, espionage and betrayal, and her affair with Baron Laski (Daniel Donskoy), a Bonapartist and political enemy. Disney calls the setting "the most opulent party of the 19th century." Hannu Salonen directed it from scripts by Stefan Brunner. In the U.S., all six episodes stream on Hulu from Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026, in German with subtitles. The history is real. After Napoleon's defeat, European powers met in Vienna in 1814-15 to redraw the map, with Austrian Foreign Minister Klemens von Metternich leading talks aimed at a balance of power among Austria, Prussia, Russia, Britain and France. The real Wilhelmine (1781-1839) ran a salon attended by top nobility and had an affair with Metternich that began in 1813; more than 600 of his letters to her were found in 1949. During the Congress their affair ended, and her renewed romance with Prince Alfred of Windisch-Grätz distracted Metternich at a critical stage of the talks. Sources on the show do not identify Baron Laski as a historical figure.

What is a public benefit corporation? Why Anthropic is a "PBC". A public benefit corporation (PBC) is a for-profit company that must balance shareholders' financial interests with a specific public benefit named in its charter and with the interests of people affected by its conduct. Anthropic, the AI company now marketing its IPO, is legally "Anthropic, PBC.". Anthropic, PBC launched its IPO roadshow on Nov. 10, 2026, and searches for "anthropic pbc" jumped as investors asked what the letters mean.. Delaware has allowed public benefit corporations since Aug. 1, 2013. Under Section 362 of the Delaware General Corporation Law, a PBC must name one or more specific public benefits in its certificate of incorporation and must balance the stockholders' pecuniary interests, the interests of those materially affected by its conduct and that public benefit. Its name may include "public benefit corporation," "P.B.C." or "PBC." Delaware PBCs must also report to stockholders at least every two years on how they are promoting their public benefit. A PBC is not the same as a "B Corp." PBC is a legal form of company; B Corp is a separate certification that some companies seek for branding, and a PBC does not need to be certified or audited. Anthropic filed for an IPO on Oct. 26, 2026, and launched its roadshow on Nov. 10, 2026, offering 825 million Class A shares at an expected $70 to $78 each. It has applied to list on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker "ANT." The company says that as a PBC it must weigh its mission of developing AI safely alongside shareholder returns.

What is a super El Niño? The record 2026 event, explained. "Super El Niño" is the informal name for a very strong El Niño, when sea-surface temperatures in the central Pacific's Niño 3.4 region run more than 2.0°C above normal. The 2026 event set a record: the daily anomaly hit 3.11°C on Sept. 21, 2026, beating the previous high of 3.08°C from Nov. 18, 2015.. Forecasters say the record 2026 El Niño is near its peak heading into winter 2026-27.. El Niño (also spelled El Nino) is a natural warming of the tropical Pacific that shifts weather worldwide. Scientists grade it by how far the Niño 3.4 region runs above average: weak at 0.5°C, moderate above 1°C, strong above 1.5°C and "very strong" above 2.0°C. "Super El Niño" is not an official category, but it is widely used for the very strong events of 1982-83, 1997-98 and 2015-16. The current event began in June 2026, Carbon Brief reported, and by August the monthly anomaly was about 2.45°C, above the peak of every earlier event except 2015-16 (2.75°C). Fourteen seasonal models projected a peak of about 4.1°C later in 2026. El Niño usually peaks in November or December and is expected to last into 2027, when most of its effect on global temperatures will be felt.

What is TSA ConfirmID? The $45 fee if you fly without a REAL ID. TSA ConfirmID is a $45 identity-verification service for travelers 18 and older who show up for a domestic flight without a REAL ID or another accepted ID. You pay online at tsa.gov/ConfirmID, and if TSA can verify who you are, the verification covers a 10-day travel period. It started Feb. 1, 2026.. Travelers flying for Thanksgiving 2026 without a REAL ID will need ConfirmID or another accepted ID at TSA checkpoints.. To use it, you enter your legal name and travel start date at tsa.gov/ConfirmID and pay by debit or credit card, Venmo or PayPal; the receipt comes by email from Pay.gov, and someone else can pay for you. At the airport you show your government-issued ID and the receipt. TSA says verification typically takes 10 to 15 minutes but can take 30 minutes or more, so it recommends paying in advance. The $45 is a payment for the service, not a penalty or fine, but paying does not guarantee you will be allowed through: travelers whose identity cannot be verified may be turned away. You do not need ConfirmID if you have another accepted ID, such as a passport or passport card, a permanent resident card, a Global Entry or NEXUS card, a military ID, a photo ID from a federally recognized tribal nation, or a digital ID in Apple Wallet or Google Wallet at participating checkpoints.
